edges.reason: _transfer is invoked with _msgSender() as the from address, so caller identity controls fund movement.
transferFrom spends _allowances[sender][_msgSender()], making the caller identity decisive for allowance spending.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before swapping.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before distributing ETH.
approve writes the allowance for the _msgSender() owner.
constructor mints the total reflection balance to _msgSender().
cooldown[to] is assigned block.timestamp + 30 seconds, creating a timestamp dependency.
_transfer gates pair buys on cooldown[to] < block.timestamp.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and the sender is not the pair.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance is positive.
_transfer delegates the actual accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains all amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard routes the team fee through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard routes the reflection fee through _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-level amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-level amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for both supplies.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate before dividing.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
transferFrom calls _transfer before updating the allowance.
swapTokensForEth approves the router to spend the contract tokens.
openTrading approves the router for the total supply.
openTrading reads balanceOf(address(this)) for the liquidity amount.
_transfer reads balanceOf(address(this)) to size the swap.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to fee wallet 1.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to fee wallet 2.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap call.
openTrading invokes the external addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading invokes the external factory createPair call.
openTrading stores the instantiated router into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
openTrading sets cooldownEnabled to true.
openTrading sets the new _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] to throttle bot buys.
_transfer requires that neither from nor to is blacklisted in bots.
_transfer gates the cooldown logic on cooldownEnabled.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on pair buys.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before performing the automatic swap.
setBots marks each supplied address as a bot.
delBot clears the bot flag for an address.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_transferStandard subtracts from and adds to _rOwned balances.
_takeTeam adds the reflection team fee to _rOwned[address(this)].
renounceOwnership writes _owner to the zero address.
constructor assigns the full reflection supply to the deployer.
constructor sets the payable fee wallet 1 address.
constructor sets the payable fee wallet 2 address.
constructor exempts owner, contract and fee wallets from fees.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the recipient of the external ETH transfer.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of the external ETH transfer.
External ETH transfer to fee wallet 1 can execute wallet code and re-enter the sendETHToFee path.
External ETH transfer to fee wallet 2 can execute wallet code and re-enter the sendETHToFee path.
External router swap executes while inSwap is set; any re-entry into the swap path is guarded only by the boolean flag.
External addLiquidityETH call during openTrading may invoke recipient code before trading flags are finalized.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenAmount exists only as the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
amount exists only as the ETH amount split by sendETHToFee.
from is the source address argument of _transfer.
to is the destination address argument of _transfer.
sender is the debited account argument of _transferStandard.
recipient is the credited account argument of _transferStandard.
tAmount is the token amount argument of _transferStandard.
bots_ is the blacklist array iterated by setBots.
notbot is the single address cleared by delBot.
account is the queried address of balanceOf.
owner is the allowance owner argument of _approve.
spender is the allowance spender argument of _approve.
currentRate is a transient divisor inside tokenFromReflection.
rTeam is the reflection fee computed and consumed inside _takeTeam.
contractTokenBalance is a transient balance read inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance is a transient balance read inside _transfer.
path is the swap route built and used only inside swapTokensForEth.
_uniswapV2Router is a local alias assigned and used only inside openTrading.
tFee is a returned intermediate of _getValues.
tTeam is a returned intermediate of _getValues.
tTransferAmount is a returned intermediate of _getValues.
rAmount is a returned intermediate of _getValues.
rTransferAmount is a returned intermediate of _getValues.
rFee is a returned intermediate of _getValues.
contractBalance is the transient balance swapped by manualswap.
